briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race toward agentic AGI benchmarks amid safety gaps

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate multi-agent systems while regulatory scrutiny intensifies. Compute shortages persist as hyperscalers race to 2027 deployment targets. DialectForge protocol gains traction in secure multi-agent deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI releases o4 with 40% gains on agentic tasks; Anthropic ships Claude 4 Opus; Google deploys Gemini 3 with native video reasoning; Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B; xAI launches Grok-3; DeepSeek-V3 tops Chinese leaderboards. Multi-agent coordination emerges as the new capability frontier.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins; new jailbreak variants target agent swarms.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits delays; Microsoft and Google announce $40B combined data center builds; TSMC 2nm yields improve for custom ASICs; energy constraints force new nuclear SMR deals.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent security protocols like DialectForge become mandatory before 2027 AGI deployments?
